scope.zh: 谁在买、为何买、怎么付钱：十五个买家／云运营商的资本开支、财报问答或服务模式，加四个跨公司主题。2026-10-18复核C02–C04；金额均为美元。先区分自然年/财年、现金购置/融资租赁新增资产/租赁本金及多年承诺，再作比较；本页不汇总为统一的AI资本开支总额。客户集中度未纳入。 本轮2026-11-12仅对选定条目补证或更新；其余内容保留历史日期，完整覆盖尚未完成。 新增Nebius、Lambda、Fluidstack、GMI Cloud、IREN、Crusoe为服务模式核查，不是财报覆盖扩容；云运营商既供应租赁算力也汇聚上游采购，客户支出与运营商投入不可重复加总。
scope.en: Who buys, why, and how they pay: capex, Q&A or service models for fifteen buyers/cloud operators plus four themes. C02–C04 reviewed 2026-10-18; amounts in USD. Distinguish calendar/fiscal years, cash purchases, finance-lease additions, lease principal and multi-year commitments before comparing. No normalized AI-capex total or customer-concentration dataset is provided. The 12 November 2026 review updates selected entries only; other content retains historical dates and complete coverage remains pending. Nebius, Lambda, Fluidstack, GMI Cloud, IREN and Crusoe additions cover service models, not expanded earnings coverage; cloud operators supply rental compute and aggregate upstream procurement, so tenant spend and provider investment must not be double-counted.

primary-read.en: Official primary document opened and read.

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方来源，细节取自搜索摘要，未逐字核对。
primary-located.en: Official source located; details come from search summaries, not checked verbatim.

secondary-authoritative.zh: 权威机构或行业组织的二手转述。
secondary-authoritative.en: Relayed by an authoritative body or trade press.

secondary.zh: 媒体或聚合站摘要，数字可能因口径或时点不同而冲突。
secondary.en: Press or aggregator summary; figures may conflict by scope or timing.

editorial.zh: 本站对财报问答与来源的编辑归纳，不是已核实结论。
editorial.en: This site’s editorial synthesis of Q&A and sources; not a verified conclusion.

title.zh: Meta：2026年资本开支指引收窄至$135–145B

summary.zh: Q3公告将全年资本开支（含融资租赁本金）下限由$130B提高至$135B，上限保持$145B。该金额是公司全年指引，不是已交付AI算力或纯GPU采购额。
summary.en: The Q3 release raises the lower end of full-year capex including finance-lease principal from $130B to $135B, keeping $145B at the top. It is company guidance, not delivered AI capacity or GPU-only purchases.

facts.zh: Q2资本开支（含融资租赁本金）$31.08B；经营现金流$31.86B；自由现金流$0.784B。
facts.en: Q2 capex including finance-lease principal $31.08B; operating cash flow $31.86B; free cash flow $0.784B.
Q2 narrowed the range from $125–145B to $130–145B; Q3 narrowed it further to $135–145B.

facts.zh: Q3资本开支$34.91B、经营现金流$32.79B、自由现金流−$2.12B；上方Q2金额保留为历史比较。
facts.en: Q3 capex $34.91B, operating cash flow $32.79B and free cash flow −$2.12B; Q2 figures above remain historical comparisons.

title.zh: Alphabet：Q3 维持 CY2026 资本开支 $195–205B，2027 将显著增加
title.en: Alphabet: Q3 keeps CY2026 capex at $195–205B; 2027 to increase significantly

summary.zh: Q3 电话会（2026-10-28）确认全年资本开支指引 $195–205B 不变（7月由 $180–190B 上调），并再次表示2027年资本开支将显著增加。该金额是公司整体，不是 Google Cloud 或纯AI预算。
summary.en: On the 28 Oct Q3 call management said full-year 2026 capex guidance of $195–205B is unchanged (raised from $180–190B in July) and again expects capex to increase significantly in 2027. It is company-wide, not a Google Cloud or AI-only budget.

facts.zh: Q3 资本开支 $51.4B（电话会口径；现金流量表“购置不动产和设备”$51.355B）；经营现金流 $42.29B；自由现金流 −$9.065B（含 TPU 系统销售带来的库存积累与52亿美元欧盟罚款支付的影响）。
facts.en: Q3 capex $51.4B (call wording; cash-flow line purchases of property and equipment $51.355B); operating cash flow $42.29B; free cash flow −$9.065B, also affected by inventory build for TPU system sales and a $5.2B EC fine payment.

facts.zh: 支出结构：约65%为服务器和网络设备（使用寿命约6年），约35%为数据中心（7至40年）。
facts.en: Mix: about 65% servers and networking equipment (useful life about six years) and about 35% data centers (seven to 40 years).

facts.zh: 期末承诺：未来采购承诺 $924B，租赁开始前及其他义务 $152B；管理层称这些是最大合同义务，部分含可变价格和数量弹性，实际支出可能更低。不得与年度资本开支相加。
facts.en: Period-end commitments: future purchase commitments $924B and pre-commencement leases and other obligations $152B; management says these are maximum contractual amounts, some with variable pricing and volume flexibility, so spend could be lower. They must not be added to annual capex.

facts.zh: 7月数据保留为历史对照：Q2 购置不动产和设备 $44.924B，自由现金流 −$5.855B。
facts.en: July figures retained for comparison: Q2 purchases of property and equipment $44.924B and free cash flow −$5.855B.

title.zh: Microsoft：CY2026 资本开支约 $170B（7月约 $175B），第三方产能交付延后
title.en: Microsoft: CY2026 capex about $170B (about $175B in July) as third-party capacity slips

summary.zh: FY27 Q1 电话会（2026-10-28）：Q1 资本开支 $45.2B（含融资租赁 $7.4B，现金购置不动产和设备 $39.4B）；预计 Q2 资本开支超过 $50B，因部分第三方（3P）产能交付延后，自然年 2026 约 $170B（7月为约 $175B）；下半财年支出将因 CPU（含更高内存与存储成本）、GPU 与移至下半年的 3P 交付而加速。
summary.en: FY27 Q1 call (28 Oct): Q1 capex $45.2B (including $7.4B finance leases and $39.4B cash paid for property and equipment); Q2 capex expected over $50B; for the calendar year spend should be about $170B (about $175B in July) because some third-party (3P) capacity deliveries slipped; second-half FY27 spend should accelerate from CPUs (including higher memory and storage costs), GPUs and the 3P deliveries shifted to H2.

facts.zh: 约四分之三的 Q1 资本开支用于短期资产（主要是 CPU 与 GPU，含更高的内存与存储成本）。财报新闻稿现金流量表“增加不动产和设备”$39.367B（上年同期 $19.394B）。
facts.en: About three quarters of Q1 capex was short-lived assets, mainly CPUs and GPUs including higher memory and storage costs. The release cash-flow line additions to property and equipment was $39.367B (versus $19.394B a year earlier).

facts.zh: Azure 收入增长48%（$33.165B，上年同期 $22.384B）；商业剩余履约义务增长73%至 $677B。
facts.en: Azure revenue grew 48% ($33.165B versus $22.384B); commercial remaining performance obligation rose 73% to $677B.

facts.zh: 管理层再次提醒：融资租赁在起租时按全额本金计入资本开支；预计 FY27 保持自由现金流为正。
facts.en: Management again noted that finance leases are recognised in capex at full principal at commencement, and expects FY27 free cash flow to stay positive.

facts.zh: 7月口径保留为历史对照：CY2026 约 $175B（4月约 $190B，其中约 $25B 为组件涨价），部分租赁改按经营租赁分类，管理层称不代表投资削减。
facts.en: July basis retained for comparison: CY2026 about $175B (about $190B in April, including about $25B of component pricing), with some leases moving to operating-lease classification, which management said was not an investment cut.

The 10-K and 10-Q were not read, so no lease or commitment bridge is reconciled. Older Q&As QA077–080 are not Q3 testimony; the relevant Q&As are QA192–193.

title.zh: Amazon：2026 现金资本开支预计约 $220B（已由官方发布稿证实）
title.en: Amazon: 2026 cash capex expected about $220B (confirmed in the company release)

summary.zh: Q3 发布稿（2026-10-29）写明“我们继续预计2026年现金资本开支约为 $220B”，并称增长主要来自对人工智能的投资。Q3 购置不动产和设备 $77.259B，AWS 收入增长39%至 $46.0B。此前该数字仅有第三方转述，现已升级为官方来源。
summary.en: The 29 Oct Q3 release says: “We continue to expect 2026 cash capital expenditures to be approximately $220 billion,” and attributes the increase primarily to investments in artificial intelligence. Q3 purchases of property and equipment were $77.259B and AWS revenue grew 39% to $46.0B. This figure was previously only secondary and is now backed by the company’s own text.

facts.zh: Q3（三个月）：购置不动产和设备 $77.259B，处置与激励收入 $1.381B，净现金资本开支约 $75.9B（本站计算，文件未直接列出）；前九个月 $175.670B 与 $3.482B，净约 $172.2B。
facts.en: Q3 (three months): purchases of property and equipment $77.259B less $1.381B proceeds from sales and incentives, net cash capex about $75.9B (our calculation; not reported directly); nine months $175.670B and $3.482B, net about $172.2B.

facts.zh: 融资租赁另列：Q3 本金偿还 $0.433B，融资租赁取得的不动产和设备 $1.472B；不得与现金资本开支相加。
facts.en: Finance leases are separate: Q3 principal repayments $0.433B and property and equipment acquired under finance leases $1.472B; they must not be added to cash capex.

facts.zh: 滚动十二个月自由现金流为流出 $42.4B；AWS 收入同比增长39%（$46.0B），为近五年最快。
facts.en: Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow was an outflow of $42.4B; AWS revenue grew 39% to $46.0B, its fastest in nearly five years.

facts.zh: 历史对照：2月发布稿预测2026年约 $200B；Q2 净现金资本开支 $53.1B。
facts.en: For comparison: the February release projected about $200B for 2026; Q2 net cash capex was $53.1B.

title.zh: Oracle：自有资本开支与合作方/客户资本分开
title.en: Oracle: Oracle-funded capex separated from partner and customer capital

summary.zh: 问答显示 Oracle 区分硬件自有与供应商租赁模式，长期合同用固定价格或成本传导条款抵御组件涨价，并拒绝给出现金流转正的具体日期。
summary.en: The Q&A shows Oracle distinguishing owned hardware from supplier-rental models, protecting long-term contracts with fixed prices or pass-through clauses against component inflation, and declining a specific cash-flow date.

title.zh: CoreWeave：Q3 资本开支指引下限上调至 $37–39B，积压订单约 $1,325亿
title.en: CoreWeave: Q3 raises the capex guidance floor to $37–39B; backlog about $132.5B

summary.zh: Q3 发布稿（2026-11-10）：2026 全年资本开支指引由 $35–39B 调整为 $37–39B（理由是基础设施比计划更早部署并交付给客户），收入指引上调至 $130–133 亿；积压订单约 $1,325亿；活跃电力超过 1.7 GW，合同电力超过 4.6 GW。Q2 问答中的延误归因（带电厂房交付而非电力可得性）保留作背景。
summary.en: Q3 release (10 Nov): full-year 2026 capex guidance moves from $35–39B to $37–39B (because infrastructure is being deployed and delivered to customers sooner than planned) and revenue guidance rises to $13.0–13.3B; revenue backlog about $132.5B; active power over 1.7 GW and contracted power over 4.6 GW. The Q2 Q&A attribution of delays (powered-shell delivery, not power availability) is retained as background.

facts.zh: Q3 收入 $3.661B；现金流量表“购置不动产和设备（含资本化内部使用软件）”$9.441B。第三方报道称季度资本开支 $14.5B，口径不同，本页不采用。
facts.en: Q3 revenue $3.661B; cash-flow line purchases of property and equipment including capitalised internal-use software $9.441B. Press reports cite quarterly capex of $14.5B on a different basis, which this page does not use.

facts.zh: 本季新增超过 200 MW 活跃电力至 1.7 GW 以上；合同电力增加超过 900 MW 至 4.6 GW 以上；预计年底活跃电力超过 1.85 GW。
facts.en: Added more than 200 MW of active power to reach over 1.7 GW; total contracted power grew more than 900 MW to over 4.6 GW; more than 1.85 GW of active power still expected at year-end.

title.zh: 阿里巴巴：稀缺算力优先分配给高价值模型与推理服务
title.en: Alibaba: scarce compute goes to higher-value model and inference services first

summary.zh: 管理层称企业客户的付费意愿更清晰，所以基础设施目前主要服务企业；对简单GPU出租让位于高价值模型与推理服务；支出受交付时点、CPU需求和组件涨价影响。
summary.en: Management said enterprise customers show clearer willingness to pay, so most infrastructure supports business customers; simple GPU rental yields to higher-value model and inference services; spending was driven by delivery timing, CPU demand and component inflation.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 腾讯：支出下降归因于芯片可得性，而非需求预期下降
title.en: Tencent: lower spending attributed to chip availability, not lower token-demand expectations

summary.zh: 管理层称瓶颈在中国的加速器受限，CPU与网络通过既有关系保障；预计设备端与云端混合推理逐步迁移。
summary.en: Management said China’s accelerator supply is the constraint, with CPU and networking secured through established relationships, and expected a gradual hybrid device/cloud inference shift.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 百度：资产减值、融资选择与GPU云毛利
title.en: Baidu: asset impairment, funding choices and GPU-cloud margin

summary.zh: 管理层称部分旧资产不再满足效率需求并更新组合；融资可用租赁或借款；提升GPU云毛利靠产品组合、自研芯片、利用率与规模。
summary.en: Management said some older assets no longer met efficiency needs and refreshed the portfolio; funding may use leasing or borrowing; GPU-cloud margins depend on mix, proprietary chips, utilisation and scale.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 主题：积压、合同型与按需需求
title.en: Theme: backlog, contract versus on-demand demand

summary.zh: 买家把已知积压放进产能计划，Oracle 用固定价格或传导条款保护长期合同——需求信号越来越多来自合同而非即时用量。
summary.en: Buyers fold known backlog into capacity plans and Oracle protects long-term contracts with fixed prices or pass-through clauses — demand signals increasingly come from contracts rather than spot use.

caveat.zh: 编辑归纳，样本为公司各自的少量问答。
caveat.en: Editorial synthesis from a handful of Q&As per company.

title.zh: 主题：融资、租赁与多年承诺
title.en: Theme: financing, leases and multi-year commitments

summary.zh: Meta的资本开支含融资租赁本金；Microsoft口径含融资租赁新增资产但排除经营租赁；Alphabet现金PP&E及Amazon净现金PP&E也不能直接混用。承诺是未来义务存量，不是年度支出；经营租赁也不应一概称为表外融资。
summary.en: Meta includes finance-lease principal; Microsoft includes finance-lease additions but excludes operating leases from capex. Alphabet cash PP&E and Amazon net cash PP&E also differ. Commitments are future-obligation balances, not annual spending; operating leases should not be labelled universally off-balance-sheet.

Microsoft FY26 Q4 official transcript — lease classification
Amazon June 2026 10-Q — leases, commitments and cash capex

caveat.zh: 编辑比较，依据C01–C04；不是统一会计口径的排名或总额。多年采购/租赁承诺可能与未来年度资本开支重叠，未经期间及重复项核对不得相加。
caveat.en: Editorial comparison based on C01–C04, not a normalized ranking or total. Multi-year purchase/lease commitments may overlap future annual capex; reconcile periods and overlap before adding anything.

title.zh: 主题：定制芯片是需求的分流还是补充
title.en: Theme: custom silicon as demand diversion or complement

summary.zh: Amazon 称 Trainium 仍需交付量与软件改善且继续购买 NVIDIA；Microsoft 保留外部供应商以保持成本弹性；CoreWeave 强调客户主导的 NVIDIA 需求。
summary.en: Amazon says Trainium needs volume and software progress while NVIDIA purchases continue; Microsoft keeps external suppliers for cost flexibility; CoreWeave stresses customer-led NVIDIA demand.

title.zh: 主题：组件涨价进入资本开支
title.en: Theme: component inflation flowing into capex

summary.zh: Microsoft 4月官方2026自然年指引包含约$25B组件涨价；7月数字的下降另有租赁重分类因素。Alphabet称上调主要因产能交付加快；Amazon约$220B指引及内存涨价解释尚属二手。金额增长不能直接换算为算力增长。
summary.en: Microsoft’s April CY2026 outlook included ~$25B of component-price effects; its July reduction also reflects lease reclassification. Alphabet attributed its raise mainly to faster capacity delivery. Amazon’s ~$220B outlook and memory-cost explanation remain secondary. Spending growth cannot be read directly as compute growth.
